Class Player

java.lang.Object
splendor.entity.player.Player
Direct Known Subclasses:
Bot
public class Player extends Object
This represents a player in the game. A player has a name, a turn order, a list of purchased cards and reserved cards, gems, and a list of nobles that a player claims. A player can purchase cards, reserve cards, add or deduct gems, and claim nobles during gameplay.
